blocks.text: Filipinos have a proverb for almost everything, especially defeat: “Ang umaayaw ay hindi nagwawagi; ang nagwawagi ay hindi umaayaw.” It is a useful exhortation to students, struggling entrepreneurs, and, perhaps less wisely, lottery bettors.
